description:
Switch the active document tab by document_id (preferred), zero-based index, or name.

Use when: working across multiple open files and mutations must target a specific document.
Do NOT use when: only one document is open — it is already active.
Do NOT use document_name when duplicate names exist — use document_id from photoshop_list_documents.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { activated: { id, name }, context } }.
Preconditions: target document must be open. Provide exactly one of document_id, index, or document_name. Side effects: changes active tab.

document_id.description: Unique internal document id from photoshop_list_documents (preferred)

document_name.description: Document name/title (ambiguous if multiple tabs share the same name)

index.description: Zero-based tab order index (leftmost tab is 0)

name: photoshop_set_active_document
